Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts

Interface CastComparator

public interface CastComparator
Decides whether a cast attribute changed, for dirty detection.

Implemented by a Cast whose stored values can differ in form while meaning the same thing. Without it, raw values are compared by equality.

An exception thrown during a dirty check never escapes it: the attribute counts as changed.

Implementation Requirements:
Implementations must be safe to share across threads and must not modify either value.

  • Method Details

    • compare

      boolean compare(Model model, String key, Object originalRaw, Object currentRaw)
      Compares the original and current stored values of an attribute.
      Parameters:
      model - the model that owns the attribute
      key - the attribute name
      originalRaw - the stored value at the last sync; may be null
      currentRaw - the current stored value; may be null
      Returns:
      true if the two values are equivalent, so the attribute is not dirty
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the values cannot be compared; the model's dirty check catches it and counts the attribute as changed
